explication: OpenRig is a persistent multi-agent harness: users define teams in YAML, start and manage them through the CLI, and work with agents through terminal sessions and the TUI. The daemon coordinates runtime and state; provider adapters connect supported agent runtimes. The README also describes setup, workspace and permission configuration, and optional terminal integrations. Edges are limited to README statements and relationships visible in the supplied source index or excerpts; several product capabilities are represented without speculative wiring.
